text:
`header.json` and `units-004.json` (`U27` and `U32`) have been updated and validated so that `excalidraw-app/data/firebase.ts` remains backward compatible with clients on previous builds:

1. **Always encrypt a JSON array in `FirebaseStoredScene.ciphertext` (`header.json`, `U27`):**
   - When `pages` is undefined or is the default single page (`pages.length === 1 && pages[0].id === DEFAULT_PAGE_ID && pages[0].name === DEFAULT_PAGE_NAME`), `encryptElements` serializes `JSON.stringify(elements)` unchanged.
   - When multiple or renamed pages exist, `encryptElements` serializes `JSON.stringify([...elements, { id: "__excalidraw_pages__", type: "selection", pages }])`, which remains a JSON array with `.id` on every item (`arrayToMap` succeeds) and uses `type: "selection"` so previous builds calling `restoreElements(JSON.parse(decrypted), null)` cleanly skip the sentinel entry without throwing.
   - In `decryptElements`, the new build extracts `pages` from any entry with `id === "__excalidraw_pages__"` and filters that sentinel entry out of `elements`.

2. **Test coverage (`U32`):**
   - Updated `U32` (`excalidraw-app/tests/pages.test.tsx`) to verify that the decrypted `FirebaseStoredScene.ciphertext` payload is a JSON array accepted by `restoreElements(JSON.parse(decryptedJson), null)` without throwing and that `loadFromFirebase` restores both `pages` and `elements` so every element stays on its own page when loading a room with no peers online.
